brief: Fit the 120 x 45 x 24 mm pocket, preserve at least 240 x 150 mm deployed extent, and prefer fewer crease segments among feasible designs.
rationale: Naive accordion (a=32 b=160) failed packed long side 160.0>120 and height 31.92>24; single-row accordion packs as max(b, x) x min(b,x) so b must be >=150 for deployed_y yet <=120 for packed long - infeasible. Miura biaxial contraction is required. Among feasible Miura candidates, d1f407d095 gives minimal crease_segments=57 (vs 72,87,101+). Measured deployed 254.13x151.14 >=240x150, packed 113.62x34.63x19.57 within 120x45x24, flat 256.22x151.23 within 277x190, crease 57 <=160.
